day: Don't jinx it. Shift's not over 'til the captain says so.
Sun's finally up. My feet are killing me.
Should've taken the day shift like I did.
Reckon we'll get relieved on time today?
Nice to see the road again. Night watch plays tricks on the eyes.
Tricks, or that flask you keep in your pack?
night: If you like the smell of dustwalker dung, sure.
Lit and watched. Nothing's sneaking past me tonight.
That's what you said last week.
Moon's got that strange color again.
Captain says pay it no mind. Captain's not the one staring at it all night.
Stay sharp. Dark's when the outskirts get interesting.
